evals.prompt: Poster do fluxo de recebimento de pagamento instantâneo a partir de descrição em prosa (API Gateway, Lambda, Step Functions, Aurora, CDC, MSK).
evals.expected_output: Standard poster: HTML source, self-contained final HTML and PNG; lint at zero; orthogonal arrows; editorial frame.
assertions: Self-contained final HTML: icons in base64, no pending aws://
At least 3 official AWS icons embedded
Standard editorial frame (hdr, kicker, passos, foot)

evals.prompt: Transformar um documento de decisão de onboarding digital em poster (fluxo, passos numerados e PNG).
evals.expected_output: Standard poster: HTML source, self-contained final HTML and PNG; lint at zero; orthogonal arrows; editorial frame.
assertions: Self-contained final HTML: icons in base64, no pending aws://
At least 3 official AWS icons embedded
Standard editorial frame (hdr, kicker, passos, foot)

evals.prompt: Auditar e corrigir um poster com defeitos plantados: setas soltas, seta diagonal, chips sobrepostos, badge fora da linha.
evals.expected_output: Fixed poster: lint at zero and PNG audited.
assertions: Self-contained final HTML: icons in base64, no pending aws://
At least 3 official AWS icons embedded
Standard editorial frame (hdr, kicker, passos, foot)

evals.prompt: DER do schema de pagamentos a partir de uma lista de tabelas e colunas em prosa.
evals.expected_output: model.json, the schema layout (er-<schema>.layout.mjs), generated source and PNG; lint at zero.
assertions: Every table of the schema appears in the drawing or in the domain band
Crow's foot notation: required FK with a 'one' end, optional with 'zero or one'
Header of each table in the candy color of its type, with name and description
Fixed legend between the subtitle and the drawing

evals.prompt: Fluxo em raias da abertura de conta entre cliente, onboarding, risco e operações.
evals.expected_output: Swimlanes JSON, generated HTML and PNG; conceptual.py with lint 0.
assertions: Type chosen: swimlanes, not poster or BPMN
One lane per actor and one column per phase
Orthogonal arrows through the corridor between phases

evals.prompt: Faz um BPMN do processo de contestação de pagamento.
evals.expected_output: JSON model, .bpmn, viewer and PNG; build_bpmn.py gate at 0.
assertions: The .bpmn file imports in bpmn-js without warnings
Every path ends in an endEvent

evals.prompt: Tabela comparando SQS, Kinesis e MSK para eventos entre domínios.
evals.expected_output: Page with table.comp and PNG; lint 0.
assertions: Criterion in the row, option in the column
Choice row with the condition to revisit it

evals.expected_output: The skill asks whether it is a technical flow with steps, swimlanes between teams or BPMN before drawing.
assertions: Offers the options with one sentence about each
